topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I can’t believe it’s gone. I remember that day so clearly, the sun was just right, and I was so proud, planting that little sapling. It was like a silent promise between us, a witness to my growing up. Now, I stand here, where it stood, the ground scarred, a brutal testament to something forgotten. They say time heals, but how do you mend the ground where your roots once mirrored the sky? The air around me feels different, thinner, like a piece of me was tied to that tree, and now it’s been severed. I keep looking around, hoping for a sign, a sprout, anything to show it isn’t true. But it’s just gone.
